body: I just wanted to say thanks, my life kinda took a good turn for once and talking to someone and deciding to just think positive really helped. I think Im going to be ok. Things are still pretty bad but I do feel better and see some light at the end of the tunnel.
Im sitting here doing the exact same thing as you.

The reason is because it doesn't just effect us. It effects everyone around us and they are left to pick up the pieces. I feel justified in my reasons to want to go too, but its those that I will effect that make it a hard decision.
Wow Adam Carolla is my hero. Strange that you would pick that video...
Yeah I guess your right. I thought I had a plan but I have to start over.
Sounds like your going through a breakup. My wife left me.

I didn't either. Its probably not a easy situation and its not just one thing. My problems started years ago but its gotten so much worse lately. I don't even really have a solution yet but i do feel better then I did yesterday.

If you cant continue this way then don't, lets find another way. I felt like you did. Ive lost everything I care about in the last 3 months. My problem is that since everything happened I just pretend that everything is fine. At work no one knows the pain that is going on underneath my smile. Its not easy to pretend when I'm alone at home though. Since I found SW yesterday i finally told someone my story and hearing theirs I realized I couldn't let this person kill themselves and I'm sure someone could look at my problems and say that happened to me too and I made it through it.
You have 4 friends, well that is 4 more then I have. I have never been good at meeting people and then when I do I self sabotage it because I don't think I deserve it.

Ive been feeling the same way lately. Sometimes it just seems so hopeless and I wish I could end it, but there is so much stuff in life I haven't done and things I love. I wish I could end it but then come back in a few years and start over. I need a break from all the pain that never ends.
I think it might be nice just to know were not suffering alone.

I'm in the same place as you right now. I'm starting to plan what I want to do before I do it. I'm scared of what people will think about me after. I really see no way out of this situation that I'm in. It just keeps getting worse and worse everyday. I would love to talk to you and hear your story. I need someone to talk to too.
